_comment: Wall-clock budgets the perf suite holds the scanner to (T-11). Milliseconds. A run over budget fails.

threePassScan._what: collectPasses (A, B, C) plus the security surface, forms, replay and policy checks, per fixture site, 95th percentile across the estate

deepScan._what: the whole estate scanned in sequence, every family, with partial results after every site

reCheck._what: re-verifying one finding re-runs one family and must cost less than three quarters of a full scan of the same site
